description:
Retrieve call logs with pagination and optional filtering.
(Tags: Calls)

bulk_call_id.description: Filter by bulk-call campaign ID. Takes one ID.

include_details.description:
Set to `false` for a lighter list. Each row then leaves out
`call_conversation`, `sentiment_analysis_details`, `llm_prompt`,
`voice_insides`, `custom_variables` and `metadata`. Fetch those for
one call with Get call log.

name: listCallLogs
